values.d:h2h_sep: the two 95% intervals overlap, so this single-photo gain alone is not statistically clear
values.d:fix_status: The numbers in this report were recomputed after that fix (cards L2-f, L3-d and L6-d), so the DINO half of every embedding now holds real DINOv2-large features.
values.d:temp_note: the temperature step changes neither top-1 nor calibration error here (0.6% before, 0.6% after), because the fused scores were already well calibrated on this test set
values.d:knn_note: The baselines in Table H2H measure what the repaired second encoder adds: a linear probe on BioCLIP 2 features alone reaches 93.2% (95% CI 92.7 to 93.7), on DINOv2 features alone 88.8% (95% CI 88.1 to 89.4), and on both 93.4% (95% CI 92.9 to 93.9). DINOv2 is clearly weaker on its own and adds +0.2 points to BioCLIP 2 (the two intervals overlap); most of the visual signal comes from the biology-trained encoder.
values.d:sets_note: but they are almost always a single species. This is not a success of the sets; it is a property of the threshold rule when the model is already more than 90% accurate (Section 8)
values.d:selective_note: below the target, and with 100.0% of test photos answered the selective step does nothing on vl600: calibration accuracy was already 96.4% with every photo answered, so the threshold chosen there rejects nothing, while the post-cutoff test photos are harder
values.d:reach_yes_vl: 3-photo top-1, single-photo top-5, 3-photo top-5, genus top-1 (1 photo), family top-1 (1 photo), backoff accuracy at reported rank (1 photo)
values.d:reach_yes_in: single-photo top-1, 3-photo top-1, single-photo top-5, 3-photo top-5, genus top-1 (1 photo), family top-1 (1 photo), backoff accuracy at reported rank (1 photo), selective accuracy (answered photos)
values.d:e2e_note: 4.0% of the answers were flagged "not in catalogue". This run used the repaired DINO loader, so live and cached vectors agree; the remaining rejections come from the open-set gate itself (Section 7.6).
values.d:dino_benefit: and even after the fix the second encoder adds little: a linear probe on BioCLIP 2 features alone reaches 93.2% top-1 against 93.4% on both encoders (+0.2 points, the two intervals overlap)
